subject: windows.design.readiness.lab
summary: Owner requested maximum practical Windows design preparation before rebuilding. Independent native WPF component lab built and runtime-tested; product rebuild not started by this task.

details.owner_directive: Develop Windows design capability before rebuilding; reduce time lost to repeated screen redesign.
capabilities: Shared XAML theme and native editable controls
RTL shell with LTR English numeric editing
Exact-size image comparison with negative controls
Original eight references visually reviewed and mapped to reusable components
limitations: Not eight-screen implementation or owner visual acceptance
DPI raster simulation only; no physical multi-monitor/IME proof
VS and Blend installed; designer and Hot Reload not tested
details.preservation: No product or parallel Windows_Clean source modified by this task. R71 lock belonged to another quality run; waited for release, did not delete lock.
